info.title: Majorsilence.Forms MCP Server
info.description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets AI assistants drive a running Majorsilence.Forms application — read its control tree, click, type, and screenshot — over the app's built-in W3C WebDriver endpoint.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: majorsilence-mcp — an MCP server for driving a running Majorsilence.Forms app.

options.name: --port
options.description: Port of the app's WebDriver server on loopback. Default: 4444.

options.name: --url
options.description: Full base URL instead of a port, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:5555/.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help.
Environment:
MAJORSILENCE_MCP_URL   Used when neither --port nor --url is given.
The app under test has to expose the automation surface itself, by referencing
Majorsilence.Forms.WebDriver and starting a server on the same port:
using var server = new WebDriverServer (form, 4444);
server.Start ();
This tool speaks MCP over stdin/stdout, so it is launched by an MCP client rather than run
directly. With Claude Code:
claude mcp add majorsilence-ui -- majorsilence-mcp --port 4444
Tools: ui_snapshot, ui_find, ui_read, ui_click, ui_type, ui_wait_for, ui_screenshot.
